analysis.investment_thesis: Parmeshwar Metal fails the Magic Formula on the most critical leg — return on capital — with ROE of just 0.20%, signaling the business earns essentially nothing on its capital base. A 12x P/E (earnings yield ~8.3%) is unremarkable and cannot compensate for a non-existent ROIC.
key_strengths: High promoter holding of 72.03% indicates skin in the game
P/E of 12 is not egregiously expensive in absolute terms
Operates in copper recycling — structurally relevant niche
key_risks: ROE of 0.20% implies near-zero return on capital — fails Magic Formula
Copper scrap recycling is a low-margin, capital-intensive commodity business
Tiny ₹189 Cr micro-cap with zero institutional ownership (FII 0%, DII 0.03%)
red_flags: ROE of 0.20% is essentially capital destruction relative to cost of capital
No institutional sponsorship suggests poor disclosure or quality concerns
Reported P/E of 12 with ROE of 0.20% mathematically implies an extremely low earnings base — metrics may be inconsistent or one-off
analysis.detailed_analysis:
The Magic Formula requires BOTH a high earnings yield AND a high return on capital. Parmeshwar Metal flunks the second test catastrophically: a 0.20% ROE means the business is generating virtually no return on shareholder capital — far below the >20% ROIC threshold I require. The ~8.3% earnings yield (from P/E 12) isn't even attractive on its own (I want >12%), and pairing a mediocre yield with a near-zero return profile is the textbook definition of a "cheap bad business" — exactly what the Magic Formula screens out.

Beyond the metrics, copper scrap recycling is a working-capital-heavy, commodity-spread business where ROIC is structurally constrained by scrap-to-rod price differentials. There is no evidence of moat, scale, or pricing power at ₹189 Cr market cap, and the inconsistency between a 12x P/E and 0.20% ROE suggests either inflated trailing earnings, a small post-IPO denominator distortion, or accounting noise — none of which I'd underwrite without years of clean data. Pass.
